title: witness-journal-log-service: five vendored copies under public-youtube sections
context: Performance-defect repair commission for @red-cup-engineering/witness-journal-log-service (O(n^2) appendSeavt dedup, fixed and published as 0.1.9). While tracing consumers this session, five byte-adjacent vendored copies of this package's source were found under youtube-section 'packages/' directories, all pinned at the pre-fix 0.1.8 line, none touched by the fix in this session.
law: Primitives live once, on the registry, interdependent — never copied (org-layering.md, item 6; working-discipline.md 'Before building').
disposition: Recorded as a finding only. Not modified, not deleted, not re-pinned; out of this commission's boundary (canonical package + named consumer chain only).
note: Each also vendors scripts/append-seavt.mjs and scripts/append-entries.mjs alongside src/index.mjs, so any consumer importing from these copies carries the fixed package's pre-fix O(n^2) appendSeavt defect and will not receive the 0.1.9 fix by any registry re-pin. Disposition (delete-and-repoint-to-registry vs. some other custody reason for the copy) is an owner/custody call, not a mechanical one, and is left to whoever owns the public-youtube-services-section and emsenn-youtube-services-section consumers.
